# 🦙 synthLlama
**synthLlama** is a powerful Streamlit-based web application for generating high-quality synthetic data using the SDV (Synthetic Data Vault) library. It supports single table, relational, and time-series data generation with comprehensive quality validation. > **🚀 New to synthLlama?** Check out the [Quick Start Guide](QUICKSTART.md) for a 2-minute setup! ## Features * **Single Table Data Generation:** Generate synthetic data from a single CSV file using models like `GaussianCopula`, `CTGAN`, or `TVAE`. * **Relational Data Generation:** Generate synthetic data for multiple related CSV files, maintaining foreign key consistency using `HMASynthesizer`. * **Time-Series Data Generation:** Generate synthetic time-series data using `PARSynthesizer` or `TimeGAN`, with options for full sequence generation or fixed rows per entity. * **Comprehensive Data Quality Checks:** * Single-table: Column matching and numeric distribution similarity * Relational: Foreign key integrity validation (uniqueness, null checks, unknown references) * Time-series: Entity-time uniqueness, sequence length distribution, temporal coverage, and value distributions * **Fast Mode:** Speed optimization with protected columns to preserve data integrity * **Data Export:** Download generated synthetic data as CSV or ZIP files. ## Project Structure ``` synthLlama/ ├── app.py # Streamlit frontend entry point ├── synthLlama.png # Application logo ├── install.bat # Windows installation script ├── install.sh # Unix/Linux/Mac installation script ├── run.bat # Windows run script ├── run.sh # Unix/Linux/Mac run script ├── pyproject.toml # Poetry configuration ├── README.md # This file ├── QUICKSTART.md # Quick start guide (2-minute setup) ├── config/ │ └── default.yaml # Application configuration ├── sdg/ # Core Python package │ ├── data_loader.py # Handles CSV file loading │ ├── metadata_builder.py # Detects and builds SDV metadata │ ├── model_trainer.py # Trains SDV synthesizers │ ├── data_generator.py # Generates synthetic data │ ├── validators.py # Validates synthetic data quality │ ├── exporter.py # Exports synthetic data │ └── utils.py # Utility functions ├── tests/ # Test scripts and unit tests │ ├── test_validators.py │ ├── test_utils.py │ ├── run_validation.py │ ├── debug_relational.py │ └── test.csv └── docs/ # Documentation ├── TIMESERIES_QUALITY_CHECKS.md ├── TIMESERIES_QUALITY_QUICKSTART.md └── specification.md ``` ## Setup and Installation ### Quick Start (Recommended) **Windows:** 1. **Clone the repository:** ```bash git clone https://github.com/git-raj/SynthGen.git cd SynthGen ``` 2. **Run the installation script:** ```bash install.bat ``` 3. **Start the application:** ```bash run.bat ``` **Linux/Mac:** 1. **Clone the repository:** ```bash git clone https://github.com/git-raj/SynthGen.git cd SynthGen ``` 2. **Run the installation script:** ```bash ./install.sh ``` 3. **Start the application:** ```bash ./run.sh ``` ### Manual Installation If you prefer manual setup or the automated scripts don't work: 1. **Clone the repository:** ```bash git clone https://github.com/git-raj/SynthGen.git cd SynthGen ``` 2. **Install Poetry (if you haven't already):** ```bash pip install poetry ``` 3. **Install project dependencies:** ```bash poetry install ``` 4. **Run the application:** ```bash poetry run streamlit run app.py ``` ## Running the Application ### Using Scripts (Easiest) **Windows:** Double-click `run.bat` or run in terminal: ```bash run.bat ``` **Linux/Mac:** Run in terminal: ```bash ./run.sh ``` ### Manual Method ```bash poetry run streamlit run app.py ``` This will open the application in your web browser. You'll see the synthLlama interface with the logo and can start generating synthetic data. ## Running Tests To run the unit tests: ```bash poetry run pytest ``` ## Configuration The application's default settings are located in `config/default.yaml`. You can modify this file to change model choices, validation thresholds, and other parameters. ## Documentation All detailed documentation is available in the `docs/` folder: - **[Time-Series Quality Checks](docs/TIMESERIES_QUALITY_CHECKS.md)**: Comprehensive guide to time-series validation metrics and interpretation - **[Time-Series Quality Quickstart](docs/TIMESERIES_QUALITY_QUICKSTART.md)**: Quick guide to get started with time-series quality validation - **[Project Specification](docs/specification.md)**: Project specification and requirements
